bestOfReason: Hook 1–4: introduce the autonomous city and unreliable mayor.
Build 5–12: organ autonomy, priorities and hidden coordination.
Escalation 13–20: physical processes become self-damage, disease and age.
Turn 21–24: empirical pioneers confront professional resistance.
Climax 25–28: production, unreliable perception, material cycling and sleep.
Landing 29–32: history, outdated theories, stress and the body’s score.

songLines.songLine: The City Inside: It has been running the civilization while you were busy with other things.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: It has been running the civilization while you were busy thinking about other things. You are the other things.

songLines.songLine: The Citizen: You have never told this city what to do. It has never asked your permission.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: You have never once told this city what to do. It has never once asked your permission.

songLines.songLine: The Manual: A machine is a human-designed system. The body is older than machines.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: A machine is a human-designed system. The body is older than the concept of machines.

songLines.songLine: The Journey: Once upon a time, there was life. Good luck. Inflammation or homeostasis.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: Es war einmal das Leben. Once upon a time, there was life. Good luck.

songLines.songLine: The Heart: The brain can modify the rate. The brain cannot generate it. The badger drums alone.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The brain can modify the rate. The brain cannot generate it. The badger drums alone.

songLines.songLine: The Brain: The decision was already underway. You are the press secretary, not the president.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The decision was already underway 500ms before you 'made' it. You are the press secretary, not the president.

songLines.songLine: The Lungs: Square meters folded into your chest. The only autonomic manual override.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: 70 square meters folded into your chest. The only autonomic function with a manual override.

songLines.songLine: The Kidneys: Liters filtered daily to produce consequences. The original doping agency.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: 180 liters filtered daily to produce 1.5 liters of consequences. The original doping agency.

songLines.songLine: The Liver: Prometheus was anatomically correct. It's the only organ that grows back.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: Prometheus was anatomically correct. It's the only organ that grows back.

songLines.songLine: The Gut: The phone calls go up to the brain. The subway runs the city. Somatic signal.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: 80% of the phone calls go up to the brain. The subway runs the city.

songLines.songLine: The Immune System: A library of every murder attempt. It remembers things you have forgotten.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: A library of every murder attempt since 1987. It remembers things you have forgotten.

songLines.songLine: The Endocrine System: One molecule creates trust and tribalism. Not a bug, a feature.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The same molecule creates trust and tribalism. It's not a bug, it's a feature.

songLines.songLine: ATP Synthesis: A physical motor actually spins. You are cycling energy, not storing it.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: It is a physical motor. It actually spins. You are not storing energy; you are cycling it.
songLines.opener: So where does the energy go?

songLines.songLine: Neurotransmission: You moved before you felt the pain. The nervous system got there first.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: You moved your hand before you felt the pain. The nervous system got there first.

songLines.songLine: DNA Replication: One error per billion letters. You had cancer; the spider usually eats it.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: One error per billion letters. You have had cancer many times; the spider usually eats it.

songLines.songLine: Protein Folding: The shape is the answer. When it fails, the memory fails. Form is function.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The shape is the answer. When the shape fails, the memory fails.

songLines.songLine: Inflammation: The response that heals the wound becomes the mechanism that burns the city.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The response that heals the wound becomes the mechanism that burns the city.
songLines.opener: Even the immune library has limits.

songLines.songLine: Cancer: Evolution occurring inside you. Not a disease, but a competitor. Compounding growth.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: Evolution occurring inside you. It is not a disease; It is a competitor.

songLines.songLine: Autoimmune: Discrimination fails, not the weapon. The gun works fine, pointed the wrong way.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The discrimination fails, not the weapon. The gun works fine; it's just pointed the wrong way.

songLines.songLine: The Aging Thymus: Your immune repertoire was built as a teenager. Hope you read good books.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: Your immune repertoire was built when you were a teenager. Hope you read good books.
songLines.opener: Except time is not on your side.

songLines.songLine: Andreas Vesalius: He looked at the body instead of the book. Everyone else was wrong.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: He looked at the body instead of the book. He was 28. Everyone else was wrong.

songLines.songLine: William Harvey: Math proved the liver couldn't make that much blood. A math problem first.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The math proved the liver couldn't make that much blood. It was a math problem first.

songLines.songLine: Ignaz Semmelweis: He saved the mothers. The doctors committed him. He died of the infection.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: He saved the mothers. The doctors committed him to an asylum. He died of the infection he identified.

songLines.songLine: The Semmelweis Problem: Evidence is available. Implication uncomfortable. Reject the finding.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The evidence is available. The implication is uncomfortable. We reject the finding.

songLines.songLine: The Skeleton Factory: Hardest structural material, busiest factory. Hidden production.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The hardest structural material is also the busiest factory. 2 million cells per second.

songLines.songLine: The Blind Eye: A hole in your vision. The brain fills it with best guesses. Trust, but verify.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: You have a hole in your vision. The brain fills it in with best guesses. Trust, but verify.

songLines.songLine: The River Body: The pattern persists. The atoms cycle. You are a standing wave. Material cycle.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The pattern persists. The atoms cycle. You are a standing wave.

songLines.songLine: The Night Shift: Sleep is not rest. The janitorial shift washes thoughts out of the carpet.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: Sleep is not rest. It is the janitorial shift washing the thoughts out of the carpet.

songLines.songLine: The Stage: Every history event happened inside a body. Caesar was stabbed in anatomy.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: Every history event happened inside a body. Caesar was stabbed in a specific anatomy.

songLines.songLine: The Humoralist: Wrong in the facts, right in the vibe. It was the first Kayfabe. Balance.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: Wrong in the facts, right in the vibe. It was the first Kayfabe.

songLines.songLine: The Cortisol Architect: The emergency system running all day. Comfort is a chemical state.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The emergency system running 24/7. The comfort zone is a chemical state.

songLines.songLine: The Scorekeeper: The body keeps the score because the body is the score. Traumatic encoding.
songLines.changeReason: Source-word compression to A4 window; canonical card unchanged
songLines.claim: The body keeps the score because the body IS the score.
